SELECT 
    a.artregistry AS registry_number,
    a.artname AS name,
    a.mattype AS material_type,
    s.lightsensitivity,
    MAX(l.lightlux) AS max_light_lux,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'High' AND MAX(l.lightlux) > 50 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' AND MAX(l.lightlux) > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        WHEN s.lightsensitivity = 'Low' AND MAX(l.lightlux) > 300 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS current_status
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN sensitivitydata s ON a.artregistry = s.artref
JOIN usagerecords u ON s.sensitivityregistry = u.sensdatalink
JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON u.showcaserefused = e.showcaseref
JOIN lightandradiationreadings l ON e.envreadregistry = l.envreadref
GROUP BY a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, s.lightsensitivity
ORDER BY a.artregistry
LIMIT 15;
